@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: pt-BR uses the English word: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes “byte” / “bytes” (LocalizableMerged.json SP27, SP28), and GNOME Nautilus pt-BR “%s byte” / “%s bytes”. Only the many branch is added for pt plurals.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteBinary.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes the same symbol (LocalizableMerged.json SP26 “KB”), so pt-BR keeps it.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteSi.sameAsSourceJustification: SI unit symbol with the lowercase k prefix, written the same in pt-BR (Total Commander pt-BR WCMD.LNG 1657 “kB/s”; GNOME formats decimal sizes as kB); kept distinct from the binary “KB” the macOS pt-BR Finder uses (LocalizableMerged.json SP26).

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes the same symbol (LocalizableMerged.json SP25 “MB”), so pt-BR keeps it.

@common.sizeUnit.gigabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes the same symbol (LocalizableMerged.json SP24 “GB”), so pt-BR keeps it.

@common.sizeUnit.terabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes the same symbol (LocalizableMerged.json SP23 “TB”), so pt-BR keeps it.

@common.sizeUnit.petabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes the same symbol (LocalizableMerged.json SP22 “PB”), so pt-BR keeps it.
